column1: # grokgod source patch registry - machine-readable index for patches/*.patch.
#   - src/shim/grok-shim.sh: `grok status` persist block (numbered patch lines)
#   id    zero-padded numeric apply order; must equal alphabetical file order
#   name  patch stem; also the `grok status` persist key
#   file  repository-relative patch path (must exist and be non-empty)
# base-sha is the grok-build authorship/application pin and must match
# PINNED_BASE_SHA in install.sh and the pin recorded in patches/README.md.
